verdict.rationale: Retell documents its own monitoring: an analytics dashboard tracking success rate, latency, cost and concurrency, plus AI QA that scores a sampled set of calls on hallucination, latency and tool usage to surface quality issues. Nothing in the evidence documents alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. Webhooks (call_started/call_ended/call_analyzed) are only building blocks for a user-built alert pipeline, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: native threshold-based alerting or notifications, real-time live-call monitoring (dashboard is charted over time), error-rate spike detection, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike

citations.quote: Build custom Retell analytics dashboards to track call and chat metrics like success rate, latency, cost, and concurrency, with charts, filters, and breakdowns.
AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of your calls against rules and metrics you configure.
The Analytics dashboard charts your call and chat data so you can see how your agents are performing over time.
